name: Will my homeowner's insurance cover flood damage cleanup?

mainEntity.name: Will my homeowner's insurance cover flood damage cleanup?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most standard homeowner's insurance policies cover sudden and accidental water damage, such as a burst pipe or overflowing appliance. However, damage from natural floods (e.g., river overflow, storm surge) typically requires a separate flood insurance policy. We recommend reviewing your specific policy or contacting your insurer to understand your coverage. We can help document the damage and work with your insurance provider.
acceptedAnswer.description: Standard homeowner's insurance often covers accidental water damage, but natural flood damage usually requires a separate flood insurance policy.
